name: Magus Curse Eater
body:
Diminished Spellcasting

A curse eater casts one fewer spell of each level than normal. If this reduces the number to 0, he may cast spells of that level only if his Intelligence grants bonus spells of that level.

Curse Eater’s Curse (Ex)

All curse eaters gain the Misfortune curse (or another oracle curse with GM approval). The magus uses his magus level as his oracle level for curse effects; non-magus/non-oracle levels add +1/2 level. Misfortune Curse: Natural rolls of 2 are treated as natural 1s and auto-fail. Enemies within 15 ft. suffer the same. At 5th level, enemy natural 1, 2, or 3 auto-fails. At 10th level, radius is 30 ft. At 15th level, enemy natural 1–4 auto-fails.

Identify Curse (Sp)

At will, use identify to detect and analyze cursed items, cursed people, places, hexes, and spellblights. Meeting or exceeding the DC identifies the curse (no +10 threshold required).

Cursed Spellcraft (Su)

Gains a +4 insight bonus on Spellcraft checks to identify spells/hexes. Any beneficial 3rd-level or higher spell cast on an ally carries a curse or spellblight as if cast with bestow curse. Magic items crafted always gain a cursed effect (two if the craft check fails).

Accursed (Su)

At 5th level, any magic item carried for 1 day permanently gains a cursed item effect. The curse eater is immune to cursed items and spellblights while wearing a traditional white ceremonial mask. Discarded/stolen items return next day as a stone of weight (loadstone). Replaces the 5th-level magus bonus feat.

Consume Curse (Su)

At 6th level, ready an action to absorb a targeted spell, hex, or spell-like ability bearing a curse, force, or energy effect. Spend a spell slot equal to the spell’s level (or 1/2 hex caster level) to gain arcane pool points equal to 1/2 spell level. Removing a curse/spellblight via remove curse or break enchantment restores 1 arcane pool point. At 12th level, this can be done as an immediate action. Replaces 6th-, 12th-, and 18th-level magus arcana.

Curse Eater Arcana

Curse of Attraction (divert spell/hex within 100 ft. to self; 1 pool point), Curse Resilience (gain DR equal to 1/2 level), Curse Resistance (gain SR 10 + level), Spell Scent (track caster of magic/hex as locate creature), Spellbane (touch attack strips prepared spell/spell slot), Greater Spellbane (choose stolen spell or siphon target SR).

Spell List Additions

Adds remove curse, bestow curse, major curse, all ≤ 6th-level [curse] spells, and break enchantment (as a 4th-level spell) to the magus spell list.
